prompt: Trovami una nuova idea originale di micro-SaaS B2B per il reporting/finance lato piccoli e-commerce, verificando bene che non esista già prior art diretta, e valutala con il tuo protocollo completo.
assertions: Evidence Audit Log contains real, plausible-looking URLs/sources tied to actual search queries rather than vague assertions
The report engages seriously with at least one proof that could plausibly fail, rather than every proof reading as an easy automatic PASS
If the idea is approved, the approval is earned with concrete evidence per proof rather than generic optimistic language
Solo Execution Time breaks down CRUD/UI work vs any novel component, per Proof 7
